description: Unique id of one employee-month pay calculation.
Unique employee code (EMP-0001 ...). Same code in every table and every workbook.
Department code (D00 Executive ... D10 Legal & Compliance).
Job role code from the roles table.
Y if the role earns overtime pay (levels 1-2 in Support, HR, Finance, Operations).
Days paid = days employed minus loss-of-pay days.
Loss-of-pay days (unpaid absence, unpaid leave, half day = 0.5).
Bonus, incentive or award paid in the month.
Performance Bonus, Sales Incentive, Festival Bonus or Spot Award.
Earned fixed pay + overtime + variable pay.
Take-home pay = gross pay minus total deductions.
